天妃そば.name: Tenpi Soba
天妃そば.desc: An Okinawa soba specialty shop in Kume, Naha, a short walk from Asahibashi Station. The top-pick bone-in pork rib soba (small ¥650 / regular ¥800 / large ¥950) features soy-sauce-soaked ribs with medium-thick, loosely wavy noodles. It comes with a free jushi or inari, and is bustling with locals and foreign tourists.
t: On this Okinawa soba journey, I visited "Tenpi Soba" in Kume, Naha City 🍜 I ate here in June 2025 😄
Exterior of the shop

The shop's landmarks are the big "Okinawa Soba Specialty Shop" sign and a white noren curtain reading "Tenpi Soba." Greenery and flowers decorate the entrance area, giving off a somewhat nostalgic atmosphere 😊
Sign at the shop front

The big sign at the shop front reads "We're committed to the noodles, committed to the broth, and committed to the meat." Among them, the bone-in pork rib soba is described as "our top-pick bone-in meat. Once you try it, you'll be hooked!" so I had to order it 🤤
Ticket machine

You order at the ticket machine at the entrance. The bone-in pork rib soba comes in three sizes: small ¥650, regular ¥800, and large ¥950. Besides soft-bone pork rib soba, meat soba, and the greedy soba with lots on top, there's also curry rice, taco rice, and even zenzai.
Inside the shop
The interior has wooden floors and hanging lamps for a calm atmosphere. When I visited, in addition to locals, there were many foreign tourists, and it was quite bustling 😄
Bone-in pork rib soba, large  ¥950  * Inari service
This is the bone-in pork rib soba that was brought out. The nice thing is that a free jushi or inari comes with it as a service, and this day I chose the inari ✨
First, the soup. Maybe it's a blended broth; rather than either pork bone or bonito asserting itself strongly, the flavor was restrained overall 😋
Bone-in pork rib soba, large  ¥950
The noodles are medium-thick, loosely wavy noodles, boiled on the soft side.
The bone-in pork ribs are the type with soy sauce soaked in firmly. Some firm soft bone is mixed in and it's satisfying to eat, but I did feel a fair amount of sinewy texture ^^;

Rating (9/15): A blended broth where neither pork bone nor bonito is too assertive, with soft, medium-thick wavy noodles. The bone-in pork ribs are the type with soy sauce soaked in and some firm soft bone mixed in, with a sinewy texture. The free inari was a nice point, but my impression of the flavor itself is that it's average. Even so, it was a shop bustling with locals and foreign tourists, showing its popularity 😊

沖縄そばエッチャン.name: Okinawa Soba Etchan
沖縄そばエッチャン.desc: An Okinawa soba shop up the stairs on the second floor, near the south gate of the University of the Ryukyus in Uebaru, Nishihara. A pork-bone-forward blended broth with soft, thin straight noodles. The "Mix Soba" (¥950) comes with meltingly tender tebichi and soft-bone pork ribs whose texture varies between soy sauce and salt versions. Bustling with locals and construction workers.
t: On this Okinawa soba journey, I visited "Okinawa Soba Etchan" in Uebaru, Nishihara Town 🍜 I ate here in July 2025 😄
Exterior of the shop
Unfortunately it was raining that day. The photo ended up being taken through a window glass, but the landmarks are the "Etchan" sign and the stairs with red handrails ☔
The "Seared Salted Soft-Bone Pork Rib Soba" banner
Along the road there were banners for "Open" and "Seared Salted Soft-Bone Pork Rib Soba." Salted soft-bone pork ribs are intriguing 🤤
Entrance
The entrance is at the top of the stairs.
Ticket machine

You order at the ticket machine at the entrance. The Mix Soba is ¥950, and the set with jushi is ¥1,000. There's a wide variety of soba too: soft-bone pork rib soba, seared salted pork rib soba, braised pork belly soba, tebichi soba, yushi-dofu soba, and green onion soba. They're open from 11:00 to 16:00 and closed on Mondays and Tuesdays.
Notes on the table and self-service
The shop is self-service. Pickled red ginger and kōrēgūsu (chili-infused awamori) are on the table.
Counter seats
Table seats inside the shop
Inside the shop
The interior has counter seats and table seats, and when I visited it was bustling with local customers and construction workers. Shops with a lot of customers like this seem to rarely disappoint 😊
View from the window
Outside the window it was rainy. From the window seat you can see the road and greenery, which gives a relaxed feeling.
Mix Soba  ¥950
What I ordered this time was the "Mix Soba." It's a loaded bowl topped with tebichi, braised pork belly, and soft-bone pork ribs ✨
First, the soup. A blended broth with a pork-bone-forward flavor 😋
Mix Soba  ¥950
The noodles are thin and straight, boiled on the soft side. The noodles and soup go well together, and it's fairly tasty.

The tebichi topping is meltingly tender. What's interesting is the soft-bone pork ribs: the soy-sauce-based ones have firmer cartilage, while the salted soft-bone pork ribs have meltingly tender cartilage, so they vary the textures. It's quite a fun touch 😄 However, I felt a sinewy texture in the braised pork belly and soft-bone pork ribs ^^;

Rating (10/15): A pork-bone-forward blended broth with soft, thin straight noodles. The noodles and soup pair fairly well. There was thoughtfulness in the toppings too, with meltingly tender tebichi and soft-bone pork ribs whose texture changes between soy sauce and salt. The sinewy texture of the braised pork belly and soft-bone pork ribs bothered me, but the level was higher than I expected, and it was a fairly satisfying bowl 👌

そば処くんち.name: Soba-dokoro Kunchi
そば処くんち.desc: An Okinawa soba shop in Shuri Torihori-cho, Naha, near Shuri Station on the monorail. A pork-bone-based soup with soft, thin straight noodles. The "Kunchi Soba" (¥900) comes topped with firmly seasoned bone-in pork ribs and braised pork belly. Sanshin are lined up inside the shop, and you may get to hear the owner sing with the sanshin.
t: On this Okinawa soba journey, I visited "Soba-dokoro Kunchi" in Shuri, Naha City 🍜 I ate here in July 2025 😄
Exterior of the shop
It's a shop in a building along the street, near Shuri Station on the monorail.
Entrance
Sign with a photo of soba
Above the entrance is a "Soba-dokoro Kunchi" sign, and beside it hangs a sign with a photo of soba, so you can tell right away this is an Okinawa soba shop 😊
Ticket machine

You order at the ticket machine at the entrance. The signature Kunchi Soba is ¥900, and the set meal is ¥1,100. Others lined up include Okinawa soba, soki soba, tebichi soba, soft-bone pork rib soba, and jushi set meals.
Inside the shop
The interior has the feel of an old-fashioned diner, with a TV and noren curtains hanging. The only customers that day were a local student and me.
Kunchi Soba  ¥900
What I ordered this time was the "Kunchi Soba," named after the shop. A bowl topped with bone-in pork ribs and braised pork belly ✨
First, the soup. It has a pork-bone-based flavor 😋
Kunchi Soba  ¥900
The noodles are thin and straight, boiled on the soft side.
The bone-in pork ribs and braised pork belly toppings are both firmly seasoned and the type with a solid bite. The sinewy texture was clearly there too ^^;
A corner of the shop with sanshin lined up

And from here is what surprised me most at this shop. I'd been thinking there were quite a few sanshin lined up in one corner of the shop, when suddenly the owner performed singing with the sanshin for me 😅 I got to hear Asadoya Yunta and a few other songs 😅
The owner singing with the sanshin
Here's how it looked 🎶 Live music, unexpectedly, in the middle of a diner.
Bulletin board on the wall

On the wall are posted a "list of famous Ryukyuan sanshin," a newspaper clipping saying "the owner's sanshin performances are popular," and lots of photos of him holding a sanshin, so this is the shop's specialty. Since it's close to Shuri Station, it may be a welcome service for those visiting as tourists 😄

Rating (9/15): A pork-bone-based soup with soft, thin straight noodles. The bone-in pork ribs and braised pork belly were firmly seasoned, with a chewy, sinewy texture. My impression of the flavor itself is that it's average, but it was a shop where you can have an experience you can only get here: the owner's singing with the sanshin 😊
